d:
He leads the F1 pack, but winning is never the plan!
Bernd Mayländer, FIA Formula 1 Safety Car driver, takes us behind the scenes of one of the most unique jobs in motorsport. From keeping drivers safe across 500+ Grands Prix to handling race control communications, he explains what it takes to lead the field, why drivers sometimes complain about the Safety Car's pace, and how the entire operation works. Plus, an exclusive look inside the Mercedes-AMG GT 63 S Safety Car!
Watch F1 LIVE on FanCode with F1 TV
